title: Elon Musk’s dangerous grip on outer space
summary: As SpaceX throttles Ukraine’s Starshield, experts warn that Elon Musk’s de facto monopoly over launch and satellite tech poses a major threat to global security. And the scope of Musk’s control goes well beyond Ukraine.
